value.output:
usage: capture_usb_unread.py [-h] --output-directory OUTPUT_DIRECTORY --label
                             LABEL [--usb-serial USB_SERIAL]
                             [--stop-file STOP_FILE]
                             [--expected-elf-sha256 EXPECTED_ELF_SHA256]

Keep formal CDC0 open without application reads/writes for 120 seconds. This
is an unread-client stress capture, not USB receive-throughput evidence. The
kernel may continue accepting bytes. BLE/debug observation is independent. Use
a unique label; no input flush, USBSTREAM setter, reset, flash or NVS write.
Every operation, including after queries and CAP8 recovery, shares one budget.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --output-directory OUTPUT_DIRECTORY
  --label LABEL
  --usb-serial USB_SERIAL
  --stop-file STOP_FILE
  --expected-elf-sha256 EXPECTED_ELF_SHA256

limits: 120s test uses injected monotonic clock; live hardware NOT_RUN
Real SIGTERM exercised only inside synthetic host process with scoped signal handlers
Kernel buffering is possible; no USB PC FPS or receipt is inferred
SIGKILL/power loss cannot be handled by finally
Previous uncooperative readers cannot be proven absent; original flock/TIOCEXCL owner rules retained
